description: Hand one task to a fresh helper agent and get back only its short conclusion; the helper's own tool calls stay out of your history. Use it for one step of a plan (A, then B, then C: one call per step, put earlier conclusions in context) or to gather scattered facts into one sentence. The helper starts empty: it knows only goal and context, has only the tools you give (default: clock; give a name without path to lend it one of your own tools) and uses your brain unless endpoint says otherwise. It is removed when done unless keep is true. Example (do a step): {"goal": "Find what time it is and say whether it is morning"}. Example (gather memory): {"goal": "From the knowledge base, find what endpoint packs are and give me one sentence I can reuse", "tools": [{"name": "memory"}], "max_chars": 200}. Errors: ArgumentsBad, DaemonMissing (daemon is missing or did not reply), ToolMissing, DepthExceeded (helpers may start helpers only one level deeper), AnswerMissing (no answer in time; the line ends with details: where its stack was kept). Details: memory node agents/thought.

goal.description: what to do and what to bring back, one to a few sentences

context.description: background the helper needs, e.g. conclusions of earlier steps; a string or an array of strings

tools.description: tools for the helper; default: only clock

path.description: tool folder, relative to your workspace or absolute; leave it out to lend the helper your own tool of that name

endpoint.description: the helper's brain pack (e.g. stupid-fast to save money); default: the same as yours

max_chars.description: at most this many characters come back; default 600 (longer ones end with [truncated])

timeout_s.description: seconds to wait for the conclusion; default 600, at most 1700

keep.description: true keeps the helper (stopped) and adds a last line details: <its stack>/ for later inspection; default false
